title: Research 2026-10-20
body: Studied: the engine's orders and fills from trades.json (last 24 h), the engine status, and the 2026-10-19 daily digest (4,725 bets logged). Evidence: no new analysis today, the digest is 18 h old and has under 100 newly settled bets since the last review. Last 24 h the engine filled 8 bets and 72 bids, all still open (unsettled). At the last engine pass it looked at 19 bets and ordered none: 18 were held back by the 6-hour trap guard (starts more than 6 h out) and 1 by stale other-book prices. The bid desk had 590 bids resting ($152.18); 1,771 more waited on wallet room. Settings changed since the last card: vigGuards.bidLevel 68 to 80 (bid margin about 3.1% to 2.5%, for more bid volume; revert if bid CLV is below zero over 100+ fills), and the ThinFair guard (no bet or bid on a thin small-brand fair). Next: judge bid fills against the close once they settle, and look at the trap guard's held-back bands for a loosening only when the CLV evidence gates hold. Engine health: the engine is idle until 08:00 ET and the keeper is sleeping until then; the last heartbeat before the window was normal, with no stand-down and the Novig read key active at 16 reads a second.
